title: Getting Started with Nosh
description: Learn how to create your first nosh.json companion file.

content.body: This tutorial walks you through creating your first nosh.json file for a web page.

steps.title: Create the file
steps.text: Create a new file named page.nosh.json alongside your HTML file.

steps.title: Add required fields
steps.text: Add the four required fields: nosh (version), type, title, and content with at least a body field.

steps.title: Add optional metadata
steps.text: Optionally add description, url, language, authors, published, tags, and related fields.

steps.title: Validate
steps.text: Run the validator CLI: nosh validate page.nosh.json
